# Godot icons

Copied unchanged from the vendored Godot source at `Source/3rdParty/Godot`:

- `Godot.svg`: `misc/logo/icon.svg` (Andrea Calabró, CC BY 4.0).
- `GDScript.svg`: `modules/gdscript/icons/GDScript.svg` (Godot Engine, MIT).
- Other SVGs: `editor/icons/` (Godot Engine, MIT). `Object.svg` is used for generic resources.

Distributed notices are in `public/licenses/godot-icons.txt`.
